author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
An essay competition about how AI upended software engineering, but ban authors using AI to write the essay is just dumb, hypocrisy and oxymoron.

If you truly understand how AI transforms your work, you should stop judge the output based on AI vs non-AI, judge the output on its own merit, whether it is created by humans, AI, aliens, or a dog.
